package main

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"image"
	"image/png"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"strconv"
)

var colorFlag = flag.String("color", "ff2010", "hex value for the background color for highlighting")

var colorR, colorG, colorB uint8

// ComputeSha256 reads the file at path and returns the hex-encoded SHA256
// hash of its contents. It panics if the file cannot be opened.
func ComputeSha256(path string) string {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	h := sha256.Sum256(data)
	return hex.EncodeToString(h[:])
}

// CreatePNG prints a status line, computes the SHA256 hash of the pdf file,
// and—if no folder named after the hash exists yet—creates it and invokes
// pdftoppm to render PNG images into it.
func CreatePNG(file string) {
	fmt.Println("Image generation for:", file)
	hash := ComputeSha256(file)
	if _, err := os.Stat(hash); os.IsNotExist(err) {
		os.Mkdir(hash, 0755)
		cmd := exec.Command("pdftoppm", "-png", file, hash+"/png_gen")
		out, _ := cmd.Output()
		fmt.Println(out)
	}
}

// toRGBA converts any decoded image to an *image.RGBA.  PNG files produced
// by pdftoppm are 8-bit RGB and decode directly to *image.RGBA, but this
// helper handles other types gracefully.
func toRGBA(img image.Image) *image.RGBA {
	if rgba, ok := img.(*image.RGBA); ok {
		return rgba
	}
	bounds := img.Bounds()
	rgba := image.NewRGBA(bounds)
	stride := rgba.Stride
	pix := rgba.Pix
	for y := bounds.Min.Y; y < bounds.Max.Y; y++ {
		for x := bounds.Min.X; x < bounds.Max.X; x++ {
			r, g, b, a := img.At(x, y).RGBA()
			i := (y-bounds.Min.Y)*stride + (x-bounds.Min.X)*4
			pix[i] = uint8(r >> 8)
			pix[i+1] = uint8(g >> 8)
			pix[i+2] = uint8(b >> 8)
			pix[i+3] = uint8(a >> 8)
		}
	}
	return rgba
}

// CompareSingleImage compares two PNG renderings of the same page number.
// If the file-level SHA256 hashes are equal the pages are considered
// identical.  Otherwise a pixel-level comparison is performed and a diff
// image is written into the generated/ folder.
func CompareSingleImage(path1, path2 string, page int) {
	hash1 := ComputeSha256(path1)
	hash2 := ComputeSha256(path2)
	if hash1 == hash2 {
		fmt.Printf("The pages number %d are the same.\n", page)
		return
	}

	f1, err := os.Open(path1)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	img1, err := png.Decode(f1)
	f1.Close()
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}

	f2, err := os.Open(path2)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	img2, err := png.Decode(f2)
	f2.Close()
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}

	r1 := toRGBA(img1)
	r2 := toRGBA(img2)

	w := r1.Bounds().Dx()
	h := r1.Bounds().Dy()

	if r2.Bounds().Dx() != w || r2.Bounds().Dy() != h {
		fmt.Println("Warning: comparing two pdfs that do not have the same dimensions might cause some problems.")
	}

	stride1 := r1.Stride
	stride2 := r2.Stride
	pix1 := r1.Pix
	pix2 := r2.Pix

	cr := uint32(colorR)
	cg := uint32(colorG)
	cb := uint32(colorB)

	for y := 0; y < h; y++ {
		hasDiff := false
		for x := 0; x < w; x++ {
			i1 := y*stride1 + x*4
			i2 := y*stride2 + x*4
			if pix1[i1] != pix2[i2] || pix1[i1+1] != pix2[i2+1] || pix1[i1+2] != pix2[i2+2] {
				hasDiff = true
				break
			}
		}
		if hasDiff {
			for x := 0; x < w; x++ {
				i1 := y*stride1 + x*4
				i2 := y*stride2 + x*4
				pix1[i1] = uint8((uint32(pix2[i2])*3 + cr*2) / 5)
				pix1[i1+1] = uint8((uint32(pix2[i2+1])*3 + cg*2) / 5)
				pix1[i1+2] = uint8((uint32(pix2[i2+2])*3 + cb*2) / 5)
				pix1[i1+3] = 255
			}
		}
	}

	outFile, err := os.Create("generated/image-" + strconv.Itoa(page) + ".png")
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	defer outFile.Close()
	png.Encode(outFile, r1)
}

// Compare orchestrates the page-by-page comparison of the two pdf files.
func Compare(file1, file2 string) {
	os.Mkdir("generated", 0755)
	hash1 := ComputeSha256(file1)
	hash2 := ComputeSha256(file2)
	entries, _ := os.ReadDir(hash1)
	for i := range entries {
		page := i + 1
		path1 := hash1 + "/png_gen-" + strconv.Itoa(page) + ".png"
		if _, err := os.Stat(path1); err != nil {
			break
		}
		path2 := hash2 + "/png_gen-" + strconv.Itoa(page) + ".png"
		CompareSingleImage(path1, path2, page)
	}
}

func main() {
	flag.Parse()
	if flag.NArg() < 2 {
		fmt.Println("pdf-diff: highlights the differences between two pdf files.")
		fmt.Println("Usage: pdf-diff pdf-file-1 pdf-file-2 [-color] hex-color")
		fmt.Println()
		flag.PrintDefaults()
		os.Exit(1)
	}

	val, _ := strconv.ParseUint(*colorFlag, 16, 64)
	colorR = uint8((val >> 16) & 0xff)
	colorG = uint8((val >> 8) & 0xff)
	colorB = uint8(val & 0xff)
	fmt.Printf("Color chosen: %f %f %f \n", float64(colorR), float64(colorG), float64(colorB))

	CreatePNG(flag.Arg(0))
	CreatePNG(flag.Arg(1))
	Compare(flag.Arg(0), flag.Arg(1))
}

package main

import (
	"bufio"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"
)

func main() {
	dryRun := flag.Bool("d", false, "don't append anything to the file, just print the new lines to stdout")
	quiet := flag.Bool("q", false, "quiet mode (no output at all)")
	trim := flag.Bool("t", false, "trim leading and trailing whitespace before comparison")
	flag.Parse()

	filename := flag.Arg(0)

	set := make(map[string]bool)

	var wfile *os.File

	if filename != "" {
		// Read existing file contents into the set (errors silently ignored).
		if f, err := os.Open(filename); err == nil {
			scanner := bufio.NewScanner(f)
			for scanner.Scan() {
				line := scanner.Text()
				if *trim {
					line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
				}
				set[line] = true
			}
			f.Close()
		}

		// Open the file for appending (unless in dry-run mode).
		if !*dryRun {
			f, err := os.OpenFile(filename, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_APPEND|os.O_CREATE, 0666)
			if err != nil {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "failed to open file for writing: %v\n", err)
				return
			}
			defer f.Close()
			wfile = f
		}
	}

	// Process stdin line by line.
	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(os.Stdin)
	for scanner.Scan() {
		line := scanner.Text()
		if *trim {
			line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
		}
		if !set[line] {
			set[line] = true
			if !*quiet {
				fmt.Fprintln(os.Stdout, line)
			}
			if wfile != nil {
				fmt.Fprintln(wfile, line)
			}
		}
	}
}
